scope: One passive public prior-owned-PID and CUA app-inventory feasibility comparison; no app selection or launch
predictions: Prior owned host may have exited after workspace closure, persisted with exact birth/path, or PID may have been reused. Inventory may report an exact bundle path or only an ambiguous display name/bundle identifier. One metadata comparison discriminates these prerequisites; never treat names alone as authority.
failure_policy: Lock conflict, pin/clock/shape/backend failure stops affected probe; retain diagnostics. No retry, app selection, guessed getApp, process signal, launch or deadline extension. No fresh callback/window/view claim from historical PID anchor. Preserve unrelated apps/workspaces.
